visualRisks.description: Water and road colors are very similar, which may cause confusion.
visualRisks.suggestion: Increase the contrast between water and road colors.

visualRisks.description: The lighthouse is not easily distinguishable against the ground color.
visualRisks.suggestion: Change the lighthouse color to a more distinct hue.

navigationRisks.description: The route path includes diagonal movements which might be difficult for some users to follow.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Simplify the route by reducing diagonal moves or providing clearer visual cues.

navigationRisks.description: There are multiple sharp turns in the route, which could be disorienting.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Smooth out the route to avoid abrupt changes and provide more gradual transitions.
